title: How to test a chat support agent before you hire them
subtitle: Three checks that show who can handle an angry customer
opening: How do you know a chat agent is good, before you hire them?

steps.line: Give every applicant the same angry customer.
Check one: do they reply fast? Customers don't wait.
Check two: do they find the real problem, or just say sorry?
Check three: do they promise only what they can keep?
Now do that for every applicant. That's days of your time.
HireFlow gives every applicant a real angry-customer chat while you sleep, and scores it.
In the morning, you meet the best three.
